question: Should `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py` remain a supported bundled helper, or is the current `skill_workshop`-first workflow intended to replace it?
rationale: Current main removed the exact helper reported here while the latest release still shipped it and an open closing PR proposes to repair it, so automation cannot safely choose restore-plus-fix versus obsolete-plus-close.

options.title: Retire helper path
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue together, documenting that current main no longer supports `init_skill.py` and that `skill_workshop` is the supported durable skill-creation path.

options.title: Keep helper path
options.body: Ask for or sponsor a refreshed repair that restores or maintains `init_skill.py`, accepts mixed-case resources, and proves the supported upgrade or release-branch story.

recommendation.title: Retire helper path
recommendation.body: Close the linked PR and this issue together, documenting that current main no longer supports `init_skill.py` and that `skill_workshop` is the supported durable skill-creation path.

likelyOwner.reason: The original bundled skill-creator helper was introduced in this history, so the product-boundary decision routes best through that feature-history owner signal.
